[$86,246](https://www.wagecalculator.com.au/#salary=86246) | ## APS Salary Guide by Classification ### APS 4 Salary AnAPS 4 (also written as APS4 or APS Level 4) earns **$79,731–$86,246** gross — roughly $64,000–$68,000 take-home after income tax and Medicare, plus15.4% employer super (~$92,000–$100,000 total package). ## Frequently Asked Questions ### What is the APS 4 salary? An APS 4 (also written as APS4 or APS Level 4) earns $79,731 to $86,246 per year as set by the Australian Public Service Commission Enterprise Agreement 2024-2027. After income tax and Medicare levy, take-home pay is approximately $64,000–$68,000 per year.
